## Scales

- **Likelihood** and **impact**: 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high. **Score** = likelihood x impact. Act on 6 and 9 first.
- **Status:** open, watching, closed (with the date and the reason).

## Risks

| ID | Risk (if ... then ...) | L | I | Score | Owner | Mitigation | Trigger to act | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | <If X happens, then Y> | <1-3> | <1-3> | <1-9> | <role> | <what reduces it> | <signal> | open |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | <...> | <...> | <role> | open |

## Issues

| ID | Issue (happening now) | Impact | Owner | Action and tracker link | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| I1 | <...> | <...> | <role> | <issue key> | open |
